from pathlib import Path
import time,json,datetime
root=Path('/home/osso/.local/state/wow-ui-sim/verification/currency-remaining-profiles-retry2-current')
target='/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/agents.slice/wow-currency-remaining-retry2-20261011t082636z.service'
cg=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup'+target)
rows=[]
for index in range(19):
    stamp=time.monotonic()
    if not (cg/'cpu.stat').exists(): break
    cpu={a:int(b) for a,b in (line.split() for line in (cg/'cpu.stat').read_text().splitlines())}
    counts={}
    for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
        try:
            group=(p/'cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::',1)[1]
            if group==target or group.startswith(target+'/'):
                comm=(p/'comm').read_text().strip()
                counts[comm]=counts.get(comm,0)+1
        except (OSError,IndexError): continue
    rows.append({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'monotonic':stamp,'cpu_stat':cpu,'process_counts':counts,'memory_current':int((cg/'memory.current').read_text())})
    (root/'partial-compile-samples.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Partial observed interval of already-running remaining-profile worker; not whole-build utilization or speedup proof','target':target,'samples':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
    if counts.get('cargo',0)==0: break
    if index<18: time.sleep(5)
if len(rows)>1:
    wall=rows[-1]['monotonic']-rows[0]['monotonic']
    cpu=(rows[-1]['cpu_stat']['usage_usec']-rows[0]['cpu_stat']['usage_usec'])/1000000
    (root/'partial-compile-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'wall_seconds':wall,'cgroup_cpu_seconds':cpu,'cpu_equivalents':cpu/wall,'observed_peak_rustc_processes':max(r['process_counts'].get('rustc',0) for r in rows),'sample_count':len(rows),'limits':'Mid-build partial interval only; sampled process peak is lower bound, group includes worker and linker/test work; no complete compile/build/jobs12 speedup claim'},indent=2)+'\n')
print('sampler complete',len(rows))
